component.name: ReadAlong
component.summary: Read the words as your audiobook is narrated

description.p: ReadAlong plays your audiobooks and shows the text beside them, lighting each sentence as the narrator reads it. Click any sentence to listen from there.

It makes the text itself with whisper.cpp, on your graphics card when there is one and on the processor when there isn't, so nothing leaves your computer. When an EPUB of the same book sits beside the audio, ReadAlong follows the book's own text instead.

ul.li: Plays MP3, M4A, M4B, AAC, OGG, Opus, FLAC and WAV, with chapters and covers from the files
Speed from 0.5× to 3× without changing the pitch, a sleep timer and bookmarks
Finds books in folders the way you keep them, including multi-disc books and author shelves
Transcribes in English and other languages with a choice of speech models
Saves each transcript beside its audiobook, where the ReadAlong phone app picks it up
Links with the phone app over your home network to keep listening positions in step

description.p: Speech models download from Hugging Face the first time they are used, then work offline.

description.p: A linked phone can ask the computer to make a book's ReadAlong and shows its progress. ReadAlong can keep running in the tray so queued books and phone sync carry on with the window closed. Sync resumes where it stopped.
